name: Talent Scout: JD-Driven Candidate Matching & Outreach Agent
description: Gemini-powered talent scouting agent that ingests Job Descriptions via webhook, discovers candidates from Google Drive + Sheets, computes explainable Match and Interest scores, simulates multi-turn outreach, and returns ranked Top-10 shortlist.
author: Deccan AI Hackathon Team

parameters.text:
=Resume text:
{{ $json.text || $json.resume_text || 'No text available' }}

Extract and return ONLY a JSON object with these fields (no other text):
{
  "extracted_skills": ["skill1", "skill2"],
  "years_experience": number,
  "current_title": "job title",
  "current_company": "company name",
  "education": ["degree"],
  "confidence": 0.0-1.0
}

messageValues.message: You are a resume parser. Extract technical skills, experience, and key information from the provided resume. Return only valid JSON.

Score this candidate against the job description on four dimensions: (1) Skills overlap 40%, (2) Experience alignment 25%, (3) Domain relevance 20%, (4) Seniority fit 15%. Return only valid JSON with no explanation text.

parameters.text:
=Candidate: {{ $json.name }} ({{ $json.years_experience }} years)

Generate a brief, personalized outreach message to gauge their interest in this opportunity:

Job: {{ $input.first().json.title }}
Location: {{ $input.first().json.location }}

Message should be:
- Warm and personalized
- ~50-100 words
- Ask 1-2 open questions about interest
- Professional but friendly tone

messageValues.message: You are a recruiter. Generate a personalized outreach message to assess candidate interest. Keep it concise and ask for their thoughts.
